name: siloables
sql: CREATE TABLE "siloables" ("silo_id" varchar not null, "siloable_id" varchar not null, "siloable_type" varchar not null, foreign key("silo_id") references "silos"("id") on delete cascade)

name: silos
sql: CREATE TABLE "silos" ("id" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "slug" varchar not null, "parent_id" varchar, "name_path" varchar, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, primary key ("id"))

name: taggables
sql: CREATE TABLE "taggables" ("tag_id" varchar not null, "taggable_id" varchar not null, "taggable_type" varchar not null, foreign key("tag_id") references "tags"("id") on delete cascade)

name: tags
sql: CREATE TABLE "tags" ("id" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "slug" varchar not null, "type" varchar, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, primary key ("id"))
